title: New York landowner sues village after access to his 50 acres is blocked
content: landowner is suing the village of Sloatsburg, new york, after zoning decision blocked vehicles from using a 50-foot-wide strip . the strip at the centre of the dispute centers on whether vehicle access should be treated as a separate land use .

title: 'Dr Strange in books, Sholay's Thakur in reality': Iran mocks UN
content: the embassy in india posted a meme featuring two panels . the meme suggested that the UN is portrayed in textbooks as a powerful organisation capable of taking action on global issues . a second panel featured Thakur Baldev Singh, whose hands were amputated by the villain Gabbar Singh .

title: CISF jawan kills 4 colleagues at Kathua hydel plant
content: four CISF personnel, including an assistant commandant, were killed on tuesday . head constable abhidesh Kumar allegedly started shooting from his service rifle following an argument with some colleagues . the exact circumstances and the nature of the altercation that led to the fatal firing at the site in Mashka village remain unclear .

title: As US cozies up to Pak, India warns it could impact ties
content: external affairs minister warns that a lack of understanding will affect bilateral ties . terrorism is of particular importance to India, he says, without naming Pakistan . india and the us had announced the finalisation of the framework for the first phase of the bilateral trade agreement .
